headline: Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19th, 2026 for PS5, Xbox
summary: Preorders open now for $79.99 Standard or $99.99 Ultimate editions. Both versions include in-game perks and a free month of GTA Plus.
details: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI is launching on November 19th, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X consoles. The game will be available digitally at launch, with physical cases containing codes, not discs.

There are two versions of the game to choose from: the $79.99 Standard and $99.99 Ultimate editions. Both include the same preorder perks, such as the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free month of GTA Plus.
The preloading phase for the game begins on November 12th, giving players plenty of time to install the game before its release.

headline: SpaceX vaporizes 260 Starlink satellites in 6 months
summary: Environmental concerns rise over burning 2,700-pound orbital data centers
details: SpaceX has confirmed that it disposed of 260 Starlink satellites between December 2025 and May 2026 by intentionally vaporizing them via re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere.

The company operates a huge constellation of over 10,000 satellites, with each having a lifespan of about 5 years, after which their fuel depletes and they are programmed to use their remaining fuel to perform a controlled de-orbit.

The disposal approach disintegrates 100% of the spacecraft, but has raised concerns about its effect on the atmosphere, with researchers urging further studies and regulations on the environmental impact of satellites.
The FCC has long excluded satellites from environmental reviews, but is now proposing to exempt them from regulations under the National Environmental Protection Act (NEPA).
SpaceX plans to deploy up to 42,000 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit and has obtained FCC approval for 7,500 additional Starlink Gen2 satellites.
caption:
260 Starlink satellites vaporized in 6 months? What's the environmental cost?

SpaceX has confirmed that it disposed of 260 Starlink satellites between December 2025 and May 2026 by intentionally vaporizing them via re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere.

The disposal approach disintegrates 100% of the spacecraft, but has raised concerns about its effect on the atmosphere, with researchers urging further studies and regulations on the environmental impact of satellites.

The FCC has long excluded satellites from environmental reviews, but is now proposing to exempt them from regulations under the National Environmental Protection Act (NEPA).

SpaceX plans to deploy up to 42,000 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit and has obtained FCC approval for 7,500 additional Starlink Gen2 satellites.
